name: German Workshop Order (Werkstattauftrag)
description: German workshop and repair orders (Werkstattauftrag, Reparaturauftrag, Auftragsbestätigung) from dealer and independent-garage systems, also scanned. Hides the customer: name or company (after Herrn/Frau/Firma, in the address window, after Kunde:/Auftraggeber:/Halter:/Ansprechpartner:/z. Hd.), street and PLZ Ort, phone and mobile numbers, e-mail, customer number, every German licence plate (M-AB 1234, LÖ-X 99E, HH XY 1234H, also in free text), the whole VIN/FIN (also printed in groups or split by a scan), any surname after Hr./Fr. (for example the service advisor in the header row) and the dealer's one-line sender line above the address window. The workshop's letterhead, stamp, footer, switchboard number (ending in -0), fax, e-mail at workshop domains and staff after Serviceberater:/Annahme:/Monteur: written as Herr/Frau or a full name stay visible, as do order numbers, dates, km-Stand, Erstzulassung, HSN/TSN, make and model, work positions, part numbers, AW, prices and VAT. Each row can be switched off (Absender to keep the sender line, Hr./Fr. Name to keep staff). Limits: on scans and photos a name or address with no label or salutation on the same line (the address window) and a customer number alone in its box under its label are not found and must be covered by hand; a workshop number without -0 (or a direct line without a Durchwahl label) is covered like a customer number; a VIN wrapped onto two lines is not recognised.

patterns.name: FIN
patterns.description: The whole vehicle identification number (FIN/VIN): continuous, in groups, after Fahrzeug-Ident-Nr./FIN/VIN/Fahrgestell-Nr., and both pieces when a scan splits it.

patterns.name: Kennzeichen
patterns.description: German licence plates: M-AB 1234, LÖ-X 99E, B AB 123, HH XY 1234H, also inside free text.

patterns.name: Kunden-Nr.
patterns.description: Customer number after Kunden-Nr./Kd.-Nr./Kundennummer, or a plain number right after the licence plate (the header box right of the plate).

patterns.name: Kundenname
patterns.description: Customer or company name: after Herrn/Frau, in the address window, after Kunde:/Auftraggeber:/Halter:/Ansprechpartner:/z. Hd. Staff after Serviceberater:/Annahme:/Monteur: and 'Herr Vorname Nachname' stay readable (Hr./Fr. Name is its own row).

patterns.name: Hr./Fr. Name
patterns.description: Surname after Hr./Hrn./Fr. (also capitals, Hr.Name, Hr. Dr. Name, a surname cut by the column), e.g. the service advisor or contact in the header row. Not Mo.-Fr. or Fr. 30.10.

patterns.name: Kundenadresse
patterns.description: Customer street and PLZ Ort: in the address window, after Anschrift:/Straße:/PLZ Ort:, or a line made only of 'Straße Nr, PLZ Ort'. The workshop letterhead, sender line and footer stay readable.

patterns.description: The dealer's one-line sender line above the address window (Name GmbH | Street 1 | 12345 City). Switch off to keep it readable; letterhead, stamp and footer stay visible either way.

patterns.name: Telefon Kunde
patterns.description: Landline and mobile numbers in German notation. Switchboard numbers ending in -0 and numbers after Fax/Durchwahl/Notdienst/Zentrale stay readable.

patterns.name: E-Mail Kunde
patterns.description: E-mail addresses, except those at workshop-like domains (autohaus-, kfz-, werkstatt-, autoservice-, reifen-, garage-...).
